Generation: Generate a timestamp-prefixed TSID with tsid() (VARCHAR) or, in the DuckDB 2.0 build, tsid_uuid() (native UUID); both accept an optional TIMESTAMP. Use ORDER BY for sorted results; generation does not guarantee strict insertion or commit order.
Inspection: Extract the embedded generation timestamp from a TSID string or (DuckDB 2.0 build) UUID. It need not equal insertion or transaction commit time.
